column3: Untouched triggers go back exactly as served (each draft keeps its loaded fields and wire args); a once trigger that already ran drops out of a changed set; an automation with no project can be edited; Save and Run now reuse their command id on a retry of the same args
column4: Devin findings on #43: lossy editor fields rewrote untouched triggers, past once triggers blocked every trigger edit, projectless standing automations could not be saved, and a lost ack retried with a new id could run twice or rotate twice
